# UI/UX, Accessibility & Visual QA Requirements Quality Checklist: Game UI & QA Automation

**Purpose**: Đánh giá chất lượng, độ đầy đủ, tính nhất quán và tính kiểm chứng được của các yêu cầu giao diện 24 màn hình, trợ năng và kiểm thử tự động trong `012-game-ui-qa`.
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all 24 mandatory RPG screens (`SCR-01` through `SCR-24`) explicitly enumerated and bounded without omissions or generic dashboard layouts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are all nine interactive/network states (`default`, `hover`, `active`, `focus`, `disabled`, `loading`, `empty`, `error`, `disconnected`) explicitly required across core UI primitives and applicable screens? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all 5 priority tiers of input focus orchestration (`WORLD_GAMEPLAY`, `BUILDING_GHOST`, `MODAL_OVERLAY`, `TEXT_IME_INPUT`, `DISCONNECTED_LOCK`) and Vietnamese Telex/VNI IME protection fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all required automated QA checks (multi-viewport `1920x1080`/`1280x720`/`1024x768` + `130%` text scale, `<= 0.5%` screenshot diff, pixel crispness, combat safe area, contrast, Vietnamese overflow/diacritics, zero external requests, Vietnamese `P0–P3` bug report format) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Are visual safety and accessibility thresholds objectively quantified (`>= 4.5:1` WCAG AA text contrast, `>= 3.0:1` UI/focus contrast, `<= 3` flashes/second hard cap, `0%/50%/100%` Camera Shake, `100%/115%/130%` text scaling)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are Vietnamese typography safeguards (`line-height >= 1.35` headings / `>= 1.45` body, `+25%` width expansion budget, No-Ellipsis Rule on currencies/rates/materials/`+10`/error codes) unambiguously stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK007 Are HUD combat safe-area geometry (`[22%..78%] x [16%..82%]`, `68%–76%` clear center) and decoupled UI sync ceilings (`<= 10 Hz` HUD, `<= 5 Hz` Minimap, zero per-frame 60 FPS UI re-render) explicitly quantified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]

## Consistency & Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK008 Do all typography, asset, preference-persistence, and QA-automation requirements strictly forbid Google Fonts CDN, third-party asset CDNs, and cloud visual-regression SaaS while keeping all storage/assets 100% local? [Consistency, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK009 Do Gacha (`SCR-11`), Weapon Enhancement (`SCR-13`), and Death (`SCR-24`) UI requirements remain 100% consistent with non-predatory gameplay rules (in-game `STARLIGHT_SHARD` only, public odds/pity, `100%` deterministic `+0..+10` without breakage, zero permanent gear loss)? [Consistency, Constitution §VI, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the Party Ready Check UI countdown aligned with the server-authoritative `30s` rule from `010-multiplayer-social` rather than hardcoding a conflicting duration? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]

## Edge Cases, Resilience & Evidence Integrity

- [ ] CHK011 Are responsive reflow rules (`1024x768` 8→6 inventory columns, 1×4→2×2 party grid, ultrawide `16:9` fairness clamping), LIFO `ESC` stacking, fallback local fonts/placeholder icons, and movement stop on modal open explicitly covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are `DESIGN_AND_PLANNING_ONLY` evidence-integrity rules clearly enforced so no fabricated screenshots or false `PASSED` production test claims are permitted, and unverified `60 FPS` targets are labeled `proposed / unverified`? [Honesty, Constitution §VIII, Spec §SC-004, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after human/lead review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
